title: Acceleration and its Limits in Gaussian Variational Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study whether the classical momentum-based acceleration that improves the condition-number dependence of gradient descent from $\kappa$ to $\sqrt{\kappa}$ for strongly convex, smooth objectives extends to Gaussian variational inference (GVI) for strongly log-concave, log-smooth target distributions. With exact Gaussian expectations, a convex composite formulation of GVI yields the classical accelerated $\sqrt{\kappa}$ convergence rate. However, when only pointwise derivatives are available, we construct a family of strongly log-concave targets for which any randomized algorithm requires $\kappa^{1-o(1)}$ queries to achieve a fixed objective accuracy, even when the initial objective gap is bounded independently of $\kappa$. Thus curvature bounds alone cannot guarantee uniform accelerated total-query complexity. We then ask which additional structure permits acceleration and give positive examples: under a Hessian-Lipschitz assumption

translated_title: 高斯变分推断中的加速及其极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究了经典的基于动量的加速方法——对于强凸光滑目标，它能将梯度下降对条件数的依赖从 κ 改进到 √κ——能否推广到针对强对数凹、对数光滑目标分布的高斯变分推断（GVI）。在可以精确计算高斯期望的情况下，GVI 的凸复合形式能够达到经典的 √κ 加速收敛率。然而，当仅有逐点导数可用时，我们构造了一族强对数凹的目标分布，证明任何随机化算法都需要 κ^(1-o(1)) 次查询才能达到固定的目标精度，即使初始目标差距与 κ 无关地有界也是如此。因此，仅凭曲率界无法保证一致加速的总查询复杂度。我们随后探讨何种附加结构可以允许加速，并给出了正例：在 Hessian-Lipschitz 假设下……
tldr: 该论文证明高斯变分推断在可精确计算高斯期望时能达到经典的 √κ 加速收敛率，但通过构造一族强对数凹目标证明仅有逐点导数时任何算法都需要 κ^(1-o(1)) 次查询，从而说明仅凭曲率界不足以保证加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Gaussian variational inference achieves the classical √κ accelerated rate when exact Gaussian expectations are available, but constructs strongly log-concave targets showing that any randomized algorithm requires κ^(1-o(1)) queries with only pointwise derivatives, demonstrating that curvature bounds alone cannot guarantee acceleration.
